headline: Zeal Education Group presented the Methuen superintendent leadership profile, which the committee adopted by roll call vote.
summary: Zeal Education Group said 98 people took part in in-person and virtual stakeholder groups, and 208 people started an online survey. Zeal proposed posting the job on December 1st, with applications closing January 3rd, and interview dates are still to be set. During public comment, Methuen Teachers Association speakers asked for higher pay, lighter workloads, and safer schools.
decisions: Adopted the Methuen superintendent leadership profile, 6-0 on a roll call.
discussion: Search timeline: Zeal proposed posting the job December 1st and closing applications January 3rd. Members discussed making a decision in mid to late February, as the budget cycle starts in March.

National posting cost: Zeal said a national posting costs $3,500 for a featured listing. Members asked whether the committee would pay candidates' travel costs, and Zeal said that is up to the committee.
Closed or public interviews: Zeal recommended a closed search to get the strongest candidates. Members said a legal opinion will be sought on whether interviews can be held in executive session.
Community input on finalists: Zeal described a ThoughtExchange where residents comment on each finalist, not a ranking. Members said they want residents to have a chance to give input.

Teachers union concerns: Methuen Teachers Association speakers asked for higher pay, lower caseloads, and safer schools. They cited per-pupil spending of $16,771, about $4,500 below the state average, and 74 educators who left last year.

decision_evidence.quote: So, we're going to vote on the profile here of the leadership profile for the Methuen superintendent. ... Okay, so that motion carries.

decision_titles: Leadership profile for Methuen superintendent search
